parties.respondent: The State of Maharashtra and Others

summary: Scheduled Tribe classification appeal; pre-Constitution documents establish caste authenticity; 'Mana' tribe claim supported by 1924 record despite 'Mani' variation; Affinity Test not litmus test due to urbanization; documents outweigh inconsistent test results; High Court erred in dismissing tribal status; Scrutiny Committee overreach in requiring vigilance inquiry.
legal_provisions_cited: Mah. Adiwasi Thakur Jamat Swarakshan Samiti v. State of Maharashtra
Anand v. Committee for Scrutiny and Verification
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Scheduled Tribe status restored; admission to MBBS reserved seat upheld.
